fusions.name: Throat Hold
fusions.desc: A weapon strike that bites and locks on. It deals 16 damage and uses up every affliction you have on the target for 60% more damage each, then leaves it [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Flanking Jabs
fusions.desc: A flurry of jabs deals 4 damage to every enemy within 2 tiles. The damage rises 8% for each ally near you, up to 32%.

fusions.name: Stand Over the Fallen
fusions.desc: A challenge that pulls up to 4 enemies within 5 tiles onto you for 6 seconds. A hound fights beside you for 9 seconds, striking for 4 damage every 1.4 seconds.

fusions.name: Mastiff at Heel
fusions.desc: A bonded mastiff fights beside you, biting an enemy within 5 tiles every 1.2 seconds. Each bite deals 4 damage and holds on, slowing the target by 25% for 2 seconds.
